intent: Inspect and refactor TelemetryConfig without changing its ast_hints API: verify layering (domain types only in ports, no blocking calls, no hardcoded config values), reactive lifecycle/backpressure, and that tests stay green. Unit: Shared kernel of Intake/Ledger integration. @Configuration (not a boot class) with @EnableConfigurationProperties(TelemetryProperties.class). Beans: Clock systemUTC (injected everywhere, never Instant.now()), and ReorderWindow built from TelemetryProperties.reorderWindow().
